name: Android
description: What a phone can be cleaned of over USB without rooting it. Photos, messages and app data are not touched.

rules.name: App caches, every app
rules.why: What apps keep to load faster: pictures, video segments, web pages. Android clears all of them at once; without root it cannot do one app at a time. Sign-ins and app data stay.

rules.name: Gallery thumbnails
rules.why: Small previews of your photos and videos. The gallery draws them again. The photos themselves are not touched.

rules.name: App caches on shared storage
rules.why: Cache folders apps keep outside their private space. Newer Android versions hide these from USB, so this may find nothing.

rules.name: Photos and files already in the trash
rules.why: Things you deleted in the gallery or the Files app, which Android keeps for 30 days. Removing them here is final.

rules.name: App installers in Downloads
rules.why: The .apk files left in Downloads after you installed an app from them. The installed apps stay.
